name: p1-platform
description: P1 platform monorepo: Collaborative Content Repository, Puck CCR SDK, AI chat, and media

scripts.dev:stack: make docker-up db-ready && dotenv -e .env.fullstack.local -- turbo run dev:stack --filter='!@p1/agent' --filter='!p1-media-worker'
scripts.dev:stack:full: make docker-up db-ready && dotenv -e .env.fullstack.local -- turbo run dev:stack
scripts.build: if [ -n "$PANTHEON_ENVIRONMENT" ]; then turbo run build --filter=@pantheon-systems/p1-registry && mkdir -p .next && cp -r apps/p1-registry/.next/static .next/; else turbo run build; fi
scripts.lint:root: eslint scripts e2e eslint.config.js playwright.config.ts vitest.workspace.ts
scripts.lint:sarif: turbo run lint lint:root --force -- --format=json-with-metadata --output-file=eslint-report.json; tsx scripts/collect-eslint-sarif.ts
